Contact Us Monday, 12 November 2018 You are here: Home 2018 November The big 5 lose 75 Billion, but does it really matter?- Stock market analysis for week- Mike “Tiny” Saul (11/12/2018) The big 5 lose 75 Billion, but does it really matter?- Stock market analysis for week- Mike “Tiny” Saul (11/12/2018) Posted on by wsw staff |
“The headline read: “The big 5 lose 75 Billion on Friday”. Was it just to get a click? Well, it depends what you’re looking for. yes, the big 5 names in tech (GOOGL, AMZN, AAPL, FB, MSFT) lost a collective 75 Billion on Friday, but the real question should be, does it really matter? Also, why am I anti Veteran’s Day?,” writes Mike “Tiny” Saul of www.attackthemarkets.com .
